checks: Original engine parity: water/flow and ice/save (DPS, casts, end mana)
Budgets: water ball 8.1B, ice lock 12.8B, thunder 27B
Fixed-rotation damage scales linearly with K; resource consumption unchanged
All runs assert mana conservation, bounded mana, and exclusive hand time

sensitivity.label: 水流占普攻动作时间约4.8%
冰凌锁只兑现80%满联动伤害

candidates.name: 较保守的20秒冰凌锁、60秒天雷

assumptions.basicPattern: 5 water casts (1 second), then 8 ice casts (4 seconds); repeat in available basic hand time
assumptions.fullCombo: Ice lock budget is already full-freeze damage; thunder gets 100% realized hits. No extra damage multiplier. Wet/freeze uptime not simulated.
assumptions.policy: lock > thunder > ball; wait for an affordable skill that is ready but lacks mana; basics fill other windows
assumptions.opening: water ball first available at 1s, ice lock at 4s, thunder at 5s; availability does not guarantee actual cast time
assumptions.scope: Theoretical fixed-combo model; not in-game measurement, not proof of a global best loadout or policy.
